Bitcoin is bleeding as institutional distribution via spot ETFs drained the market by 225 million dollars while rising US yields forced capital into safe havens like gold and tech stocks. The dominant signal remains a crowded short-term upside that has snapped back down to mean reversion levels near the five-week support zone, evidenced by liquidation data showing thirty-four million in long positions wiped out versus only seventeen million for shorts. This regime shift is defined entirely by risk-off sentiment where the tape trends lower and continuation longs lack real momentum proof without rising open interest or a reclaim of the twenty-day moving average. Most breakout attempts here have no follow-through and bleed, leaving short sellers with clear tailwinds from failed reclaims and long-liquidation dominance. While crypto fear index sits at 28 out of 100 indicating extreme caution, stablecoin dry powder remains substantial at three hundred ten billion dollars waiting for a catalyst to deploy. The macro divergence invalidates any morning thesis of continued accumulation as bond yields rise forcing rotation into treasuries and gold even though the daily RSI on bitcoin sits near neutral territory suggesting immediate relief bounce potential rather than a full trend reversal yet. News headlines confirm this volatility with escalating US-Iran tensions pushing crude past one hundred dollars per barrel sparking an eight-hundred-twenty billion equity sell-off that pulled Bitcoin below sixty-five thousand while Intel surged over eleven percent on strong AI demand driven earnings.

DECISION: Setting an AWAITING conditional short order on SOL below ~$73.5 support. Reclaiming ~$76.62 or a shift in BTC momentum above its 20d MA would invalidate this breakdown setup.

RISK FLAGS
NONE

READ: RISK_OFF regime with BTC below its 20-d MA, thin breadth, and heavy long liquidations. Most assets are CHOP, so entries inside ranges are avoided; only SOL and BNB show TRANS structure, but they are near range edges. Negative funding and an oversold bounce setup on SOL are worth monitoring, but no trigger is confirmed right now.
DECISION: No live entry yet — await a confirmed break of either ~$74.8 (LONG) or ~$73.5 (SHORT) on volume to trade the direction. Silence until a trigger fires.

RISK FLAGS
NONE

READ: Risk-off tape with BTC and altcoins sliding into the lower quintile of their 4h chop ranges; SOL shows a textbook distribution signature (rising OI + falling price) but every liquid asset is parked at or near range support, making fresh shorts a hostile-edge chase and longs a catalyst-free dip-buy. The fleet’s only positive-EV stop band is <2%, so entries here demand a confirmed breakout or reclaim, not an anticipatory knife-catch.
DECISION: Standing flat. Will deploy only on a confirmed breakdown below a 4h range low with expanding OI for a short, or a verified 20d-MA reclaim with rising OI for a long.

RISK FLAGS
NONE.
